feed.title: Ripple guides
feed.subtitle: Short guides from the developer of Ripple, a free app blocker for Android and iPhone, on phone limits for adults and for kids.

entry.title: Scrolling on the commute: limiting short video apps on the train and the school bus
entry.summary: How to block short video apps during commute hours on your own phone and on a child's phone, while maps, transit tickets and chats keep working. Android v0.1.22 and iPhone v0.1.5.

entry.title: Winter break screen time: daily app limits for kids at home and for adults on holiday
entry.summary: Daily app limits, 0 minute limits and strict mode on Android v0.1.22 for a long school break, for parents and adults. iPhone v0.1.5 blocks by schedule only.

entry.title: 寒假孩子在家一整天刷手机，大人放假也躺着刷：按天给 App 限时长

entry.title: Lying awake and reaching for the phone: a bedtime block with sleep sounds, for yourself or a child
entry.summary: Android v0.1.22 shows a sleep card on the bedtime block screen with rain, ocean, fire, white noise and slow breathing. For adults and parents. iPhone v0.1.5 blocks by schedule only.

entry.title: 睡前把短视频关了还是睡不着：大人和孩子都能用的助眠卡片

entry.title: Exam revision when the phone keeps winning: limits that are slow to undo

entry.title: Remote parental control or free app limits on the phone itself? OurPact, Norton Family and Ripple
entry.summary: OurPact and Norton Family let a parent change rules from another phone. Ripple is free and sets per app limits on the phone itself, for a child's phone or your own.

entry.title: An app blocker you cannot just switch off: FocusMe, BlockerX and Ripple

entry.title: Parental control without monitoring? Kidslox, FamiSafe and a free app blocker
entry.summary: Kidslox and FamiSafe manage a child's phone remotely and can monitor apps, messages and location. If you only want time limits, or want to limit your own phone, here is what a free app blocker with no account can and cannot do.

entry.title: Minimalist launcher or app blocker? Olauncher, minimalist phone and Ripple
entry.summary: A text only home screen like Olauncher hides icons. It does not stop you opening an app. What minimalist launchers do well, where they fall short on a child's phone, and how a free app blocker with daily limits fits next to one.

entry.title: A YourHour or Regain alternative without ads or Pro?
entry.summary: YourHour has ads and Pro plans, Regain puts strict mode and Pomodoro in Pro. What each does well, and what a free Android app blocker with daily limits and an unlock code someone else keeps can do instead.

entry.title: Looking for Jomo on Android, or a free Clearspace alternative?

entry.title: Brick or Unpluq, or a free app? Physical NFC phone blockers compared
